profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer (Frontend)
profile.summary:
13 years of experience in Web Design & Web Development,  generating skills in web applications and communication, focusing on developing, designing, implementing & maintaining online e-commerce websites for different fields, using advanced programming languages including, JavaScript and frameworks React, Angular, Vue, AJAX, .NET, Ruby, HTML5, PHP frameworks Zend, Laravel, CodeIgniter and CSS3, for responsive design functionality to expedite the launch of mobile applications complete with highly optimized stylesheets with user-agent & screen size detection for all popular mobile platforms. Developed Facebook application and implemented social media plugins. Also Experience in open source e-commerce and Content Management systems platforms custom development and plugins: Joomla, Drupal, Magento, OpenCart, ZenCart, VirtueMart, WordPress Ecommerce, Interspire.

Experience with industry leading platforms such as Demandware, Shopify , Volusion, BigCommerce, ATG & Venda. Created & integrated functionality within Eclipse and Demandware UX Studio. 

Knowledge in connecting customers through email distribution and social media initiatives.

Specialties: UI Design and functionality, front end development, CSS3, Javascript & HTML5., Jquery, Node.js, AngularJS, Backbone, PHP, Ruby on Rails,  .NET, React, Source controls, SVN, GIT,  Digital commerce best practices.

positions.title: Front-End Web Developer
positions.description:
BoatSetter.com is a one-of-a-kind, collaborative initiative designed to give boat owners and renters a mutually beneficial, cost-effective boat-sharing experience.

BoatSetter.com provides prospective boat renters with unprecedented access to the finest selection of privately owned boats while solving the biggest problem associated with boat ownership: high costs. 

Deliver best-in-class HTML5/CSS3/JQuery front-end code across a broad array of 
interactive web and mobile projects for the boatsetter application. 
• Understand the functiomality of.each module and interpret web and mobile UX/UI; adhere to and extrapolate 
complex design systems and apply to coded pages, screens, and states.
• Develop and test across multiple browsers, platforms, and devices, including 
smartphones and tablets. 
• Understand when mobile web apps are appropriate as opposed to native applications.
• working im daily basis with CSS systems such as LESS and SASS to compile style files
o PHP include function to manage common elements
on Zend framework
o Subversion or other version control system
o Analytics solutions, such as Google Analytics
o Developing for search engine optimization
o Standards-compliant code
o Integrating HTML/CSS into PHP Zend framework environment 
• Work with client services, sales, and the design team, and manage time across multiple 
projects and tasks in a deadline-driven, team environment. 
• Participate in discussions with team members about technical best practices 
and help teams identify optimal technical solutions.

positions.title: Front-End Web Developer
positions.description:
Tambourine drives revenue for hotels and destinations worldwide using advanced marketing technology. We create inspiring digital experiences and engaging campaigns that produce measurable results.

Implement interfaces and web pages based on front-end guidelines
Work across desktop and mobile platforms
Look for ways to evolve the user experience in the form of smart design solutions and new user interactions
Work collaboratively with creative and development teams to ensure concepts are delivered accordingly and to gather requirements, design and develop web-based applications in an fast paced environment. 
Create elegant, scalable websites , object-oriented JavaScript implementing the latest technology. 
Ensure wireframe, design and content deliverables are completed on time meeting business requirements, site and CMS component standards
Collaborate with solution developers in solving problems in an iterative fashion
Create and execute all front-end development with HTML5, CSS node.js, angularJS, PHP for site components, templates and content pages
Integrate brand creative direction, and usability to ensure precise execution of deliverables
Support, maintain and improve existing web based applications.

company.name: Tambourine: integrated digital marketing for hospitality & travel

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Ecomm Strategies LLC is the parent company of our own online retail stores. We also provide web solutions in many of the current ecommerce platforms. Wed design is one of our stongest areas. As the Creative Director at Ecomm Strategies, Managing and overseeing the user experience and interface design of all projects that come through the door. Working closely with clients during all phases of the development cycle to determine what features are needed for their software and ecommerce solutions and how to best implement them.

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description:
Work closely with Project Managers and Graphic Marketing Designers of the Development Team to both develop detailed specification projects with clear deliverables and timelines, and to ensure timely completion of deliverables.

Produce project estimates during development process, including expertise required, total number of people required, total number of development hours required, etc.
Attend client meetings during the sales process and during development.

Work closely with Project Managers to build and refine graphic designs for websites. 

Work on daily basis with Photoshop, Fireworksm Illutrator, Dreamweaver, Coda, etc/

Convert raw images and layouts from a graphic designer into CSS/XHTML themes.

Application and research of latest technologies in the Web Area to use in our latest projects.

Apply best practices for Marketing Website to grab the attention of the user.

Determine appropriate architecture, and other technical solutions, and make relevant recommendations to others in the team.

Communicate to the Project Manager with efficiency and accuracy any progress and/or delays.

Engage in outside-the-box thinking to provide high value-of-development to the whole team.
Alert colleagues to emerging technologies or applications and the opportunities to integrate them into operations and activities.
Be actively involved in and contribute regularly to the development community of the CMS of choice.
Develop innovative, reusable Web-based tools for activism and community building.

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description:
The Integrated Marketing group are professionals with a proven track record in strategic planning, advertising, media, public relations, media outreach, film and video production, special events, conferences and meetings, mobile, e-marketing, educational programs and entertainment marketing.

As Web Designer in charge of the developing and programming, creating the company Website and other marketing projects for the Government like supporting the Florida National Guard in a 12 months assignment to build landing pages and other supportive services. Also maintaining internal web applications and communication. Some of the programming languages used for these proejcts are Flash (for marketing websites), Java Script, HTML, PHP and HTML5. Also in charge of the web marketing which includes social media and email marketing . Expertise in Google analytics to the state of the art Omniture.
